user_request_note: Relayed D27 question (/opt/core_node_trees/www/core_node_trees). The name core_node_trees no longer appears in any code: a grep outside .claude finds it only in docs_fix/REQUIREMENTS_20260927_DUAL_BOOT_DRIVE_LAYOUT.md and CLIENT_KEY_AUTH_AUDIT_FIX.md, where it is recorded as removed. The directory was the old D27-era ext4 tree root, which was bind-mounted onto /www/core_node_trees to serve Windows node_modules/vendor/.venv junctions. It was superseded by the D28/D30 contract keys trees_root.linux=/opt/core_node/trees and trees_mount_linux=/www/core_node_compiler/trees (config/service_contract.json:173-177). Any /opt/core_node_trees left on a Linux host is therefore an orphan from the old design. Removing it is a destructive action on the host, which needs the user's approval and belongs to shell-linux, not to this Windows review.
